endangerment.comment: Esperanto (epo-epo) = 3 (Wider communication). Constructed language in 1887 by L. L. Zamenhof hoping to bring about world peace. Widely spoken internationally in the 20th century. Used at home, communication, among close friends, literature, and in literary publications.
